extra.reason: Fixed: webhook handler now uses mapping.Pubkey (hex) for all 'p' tags and builds 'a' coordinates as 30617:<hex>:<repo-id> via new repoAddr() helper. Covered by new regression tests (TestNoNpubInSemanticTags, TestPR/Issue_*).
Fixed alongside phase1-9gl: PR and issue status events (1630-1633) now include the repo 'a' coordinate tag. Guarded by TestPR_OpenedEmitsHexTaggedEvents.

Added internal/webhook/handler_test.go: 8 tests covering HMAC accept/reject, method-not-allowed, push delegation+CI hook, unknown-repo no-op, PR opened/merged, issue opened/labeled, and hex-tag regression guards. Introduced Publisher interface for testability.
Fixed in this session: added err checks before resp.Body.Close() in nip55handler_test.go; go vet ./... is now clean.

Recovery complete: re-imported 48 issues from git HEAD:.beads/issues.jsonl into the empty Dolt backend; added embeddeddolt/, backup/, dolt-server.* and export-state.json to .beads/.gitignore so runtime artifacts stay untracked; bd export writes issues.jsonl for git-tracked history.

Implemented: handlePatchPush now (1) validates the refs/nostr/<id> is a 64-hex event id, (2) best-effort fetches the referenced kind:1617 patch via new publisher.FetchEvent (relay QuerySync), and (3) publishes a kind:1631 applied status with e=<patch-id>, a=30617:<hex>:<repo>, p=maintainer(+patch author when resolved), and applied-as-commits=<pushed SHA>. Emission is resilient to fetch failure/propagation lag since the git ref push is authoritative. Note: the bridge intentionally does NOT synthesize+sign a kind:1617 when absent — that would misattribute contributor authorship to the bridge key; the applied-status carries the landed commit instead. Tests: 4 webhook patch-push tests + publisher FetchEvent no-relay test.

Done: removed webhook.Handler.PublishAnnouncement (dead + semantically wrong — it would sign a kind:30617 with the BRIDGE key, misattributing the owner's repo announcement). Replaced with a comment documenting the correct model: the owner signs their 30617, the bridge caches it (provisioner.CacheAnnouncementEvent) and rebroadcasts it verbatim (publisher.republishAnnouncement). splitFullName was already removed in the prior commit.

Implemented and tested: webhook ingestion (HMAC + routing), BRIDGE_NSEC signing config, and publishToRelays/FetchEvent relay foundation all exist and are exercised by tests. Live multi-relay integration coverage tracked separately under epic-test-001.

Implemented: 30618 state-event construction (bridge-signed, correct hex tags, deterministic order) is now unit-tested with signature verification; 30617 owner-signed announcement rebroadcast is implemented via cache+republish. End-to-end live-relay republish integration test tracked under new issue.

Implemented via phase1-cwt: refs/nostr patch push now emits a NIP-34-compliant kind:1631 applied status referencing the patch (e), repo (a=30617:hex:repo), maintainer+author (p), and landed commit (applied-as-commits). Covered by 4 webhook patch-push tests + FetchEvent test.
Implemented + tested: handlePR emits 1618/1619 plus 1630-1633 status with valid hex tags and repo coordinate. Covered by TestPR_OpenedEmitsHexTaggedEvents and TestPR_MergedEmitsAppliedStatus.

Implemented + tested: handleIssue emits 1621 + status, labeled/unlabeled emits 1985 with hex 'p' and 30617:hex:repo 'a'. Covered by TestIssue_OpenedEmitsHexTaggedEvents and TestIssue_LabeledEmitsNIP32Label.
